correctness.rationale: The frozen proof computes Fourier eigenvalues E_j=2J1c_j+2J2(2c_j²−1). Each collision E_k=E_l occurs at r=−1/[2(c_k+c_l)], positive exactly k+l≥m+1. For prime p the c_j are Q-independent by the cyclotomic minimal polynomial; no repeated resonance or triple collision. Counting gives floor(m²/4). At generic doublets, two sinks have nonzero 2×2 observation minor since p prime and d≠0. At a collision, the unique fourfold eigenspace has observation rank two, hence precisely two dark modes. Dissipative K eigenvalues on the orthogonal complement strictly decay and survival is the dark projector. Independently evaluated the exact Gram inverse site formula for all d,x and resonances at p=5,7,11,13 using explicit Fourier basis (not running repository checker). Numerical comparisons corroborate symbolic all-prime proof, no claim of finite-time uniformity.
